planets.name: HD 235088 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 235088 with a 7.43-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HD 235088 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 235088. Its orbit and size follow Nardiello et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
